record.title: Canada COVID restrictions on ordinary tourist entry from United States
record.direction: Inbound to Canada from the United States.
record.movement: Ordinary foreign tourist, recreational and entertainment visitors entering Canada from the United States who did not qualify under a separate family, compassionate, national-interest or other exemption.
record.exceptions: Canadian citizens, permanent residents, protected persons and registered Indigenous persons retained entry rights. Essential work, trade and study continued. Qualifying immediate/extended family, compassionate, national-interest and authorized sporting entrants were exempt under evolving conditions, including some discretionary journeys.
record.enforcement: CBSA documented the policy and continued tourist exclusion before July 5. Statistics Canada retrospectively identifies the August 9 reopening and increased US-resident car entries in CBSA port data; this is not universal gate-level observation.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Limit importation and spread of COVID-19.
record.context: 9 August phase admitted vaccinated US citizens/permanent residents resident in US; 7 September broadened vaccinated access.
record.uncertainty: The interval applies only to ordinary tourist/recreational foreign visitors without another exemption. August 9, 2021 was the first broad tourist relaxation for fully vaccinated US citizens/permanent residents residing in and travelling from the United States; it did not remove all restrictions. Separate family and other discretionary exemptions existed earlier. March 18 was the announcement, while March 21 was the effective land-border start. July 5 quarantine relief was not an ordinary-tourist reopening. Statistical coverage is incomplete and does not identify every entrant as a tourist.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated partial reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure. March 21, 2020 to August 9, 2021 measures the restriction on ordinary foreign tourist/recreational entry without another exemption until the first broad US-resident vaccinated tourist reopening. It does not measure every nonessential foreign journey or total border closure.
